text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove seemed somewhat drowsy
during our meeting. When I asked why—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...A bug appeared in the dorm in the middle of the night,
and I was recruited to help exterminate it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's making such a fuss...
Things like that are done for with a single whack from a newspaper.
choice_data_list: You're not scared of bugs, huh.
You're not scared of bugs, are you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...There were a lot of little kids at the facility.
They asked me to do it often, so..."

I was surprised by that unexpected side of her, but...
with all the bug commotion,
Admire Groove didn't seem to get much rest.
